'''Resurrection Lab''' is a location found in the [[Morgue]]. It remains locked behind the Old Door, only can be repaired after complete the [[Quests|quest]] "[[Sweet Dreams]]". Here, every {{Icon|Envy|size=20}}, the [[Keeper]] can create new [[zombies]].
